text: Leydi ndin jalbirora, tuma Jeyɗo ndi On feeñiroyta ñaawugol hakkunde jeyaaɓe ɓen. Talki golle ɗin sennditee, Annbaaɓe ɓen addee, mofte Muhammadu (jom kisiyee ɗen) ɓadine, fii seeditanagol ɓeya Annabaaɓe, e yimɓe maɓɓe ɓen. Allah ñaawira nunɗal hakkunde maɓɓe, wonaa ɓe tooñeteeɓe nden Ñalnde: goɗɗo ɓeydantaake bonɗi, o ɗuytantaake moƴƴi.
